meta.name: Major League Soccer
meta.notice: Fixtures and results come from a free multi-source pipeline. Attack and defense ratings are fitted from 809 completed matches using a Bayesian state-space Poisson model. Polymarket and Kalshi season-winner and exact 1X2 match prices are displayed as independent comparisons when exact markets are available. Each source is normalized within its event for like-for-like comparison; a simple cross-market consensus is also shown. None of these prices are used as model inputs.

match_markets.note: Active soccer events are discovered through Polymarket's events endpoint first; public-search is only a fallback. Only exact three-outcome match-result markets are accepted, and market prices remain comparison-only.

sanity_checks.note: Match-market checks are informational and never change model probabilities.
Sanity checks never feed Polymarket prices into the Bayesian model.

kalshi.price_method: bid/ask midpoint when usable; otherwise last trade

match_markets.price_method: bid/ask midpoint when usable; otherwise last trade; 1X2 normalized to 100%
match_markets.discovery_method: status-agnostic events plus markets fallback within the configured Kalshi series

sanity_checks.note: Kalshi match-market checks are informational and never change model probabilities.
Sanity checks never feed Kalshi prices into the Bayesian model.

market_consensus.method: Equal-weight mean of available normalized estimates; no market data enters the Bayesian model

market_comparison.season_winner_prices: The pipeline retrieves one exact season-winner event from each exchange. Polymarket contract prices and Kalshi bid/ask midpoint estimates are normalized within their own event when coverage is sufficient.
market_comparison.match_prices: A match comparison is published only for a date-verified full-match home/draw/away event that matches both clubs and contains all three outcomes.
market_comparison.kalshi_price_method: Kalshi uses the midpoint of the best Yes bid and ask when the spread is usable; otherwise the latest trade is used. The three match outcomes are then normalized to 100%.
market_comparison.consensus: Market consensus is the equal-weight mean of the available normalized Polymarket and Kalshi estimates. It is diagnostic only.
market_comparison.edge_definition: Bayesian probability minus the selected external-market probability

preseason_calibration.last_fitted_state: The fitted time axis ends at the last completed match.
